title: Chapter 68 — The Go-To Position: Becoming the Market's Default
intro: Market position as an asset — reputation and visibility.

sections.title: Become the Default
sections.content:
The ultimate trade position is being the market's default — the store every builder, designer, and contractor thinks of first. This takes years of consistent execution, networking, and relationship building.

It cannot be bought with advertising. It is earned one flawless project at a time.

sections.title: Coaching Rule
sections.content:
When evaluating market position, ask:

Is the salesperson known in the local trade community — or invisible?
Are inbound trade inquiries growing — indicating reputation?
Is the store positioned as the trade default — or one of many options?
